_readme: Editorial layer. Rooms decide what hangs in the main gallery and in what order. Any work not placed in a room, or listed in 'storeroom', goes to the Storeroom (the reserve collection) at the bottom of the page. Works their builder marked as not polished also go to the Storeroom unless listed in 'promote'. 'hidden' removes a work entirely. 'demoUrls' maps a work to its deployed demo (Cloudflare Workers, <slug>.heartfeltcode.com); without one, the local http://localhost:<port> link shows in dev only.

rooms.title: Made for the carrier
rooms.note: Consumer apps that mobile operators sell to their subscribers, from Iraq to Senegal. People arrive from a text message, on a phone and often on a slow connection, and pay through their phone bill, so every screen has to load fast and make sense at a glance. Between them they ship in four languages and both reading directions.

rooms.title: Keeping the courts booked
rooms.note: One sports academy, three surfaces: a staff portal (with a phone app for staff out on the fields), a booking site for customers, and a tennis variant built for another club.

rooms.title: Software that runs a business
rooms.note: Products for people who use them every day: gym owners, lab technicians, nursery staff. Offline-first where the wifi is bad, bilingual where the staff are.

rooms.title: ShopRaha & BTR, 2021–2025
rooms.note: Four years at a Kuwaiti grocery and logistics company, building the dashboards, warehouse tools and storefronts that ran the business as part of a larger team. Each project states my part.

rooms.title: Smaller sites
rooms.note: Websites for a waterproofing manufacturer, a hotel café, a driving school and my own small consultancy, plus one Android experiment.
